brands.name: SR Surfboards
brands.short_description: Hand-shaped surfboards by Scott Romig in Frisco, North Carolina — built start to finish in the Outer Banks with US Blanks, Hexcel fiberglass, and Silmar resin.

models.name: OBX Fish
models.description: This template was developed in Morocco and is one of my all time favorite performance fish outlines. The outline features a moderately wide nose, a forward wide point and a slight hip that pulls into a tighter swallow tail. It has been adapted a bit for the waves encountered in the Outer Banks with a slightly more thinned out tail for control in steeper faces. A concave deck gets your feet closer to the water without too much reduction in volume. The bottom is a double concave inside of a belly vee that flattens a bit mid board and then reaccelerates out the tail, giving the board a somewhat aggressive rail line rocker, while flattening out the stringer line rocker. Paired with the deep double concaves, this board is incredible fast and responsive on rail. Glassed in a 4oz Outer Banks nautical chart fiber lam plus 6oz S cloth on the deck and 4oz S cloth plus a 4oz S fin patch on the bottom. Made using US blanks with an applecore stringer for a bit more break resistance and Lati wood plug reinforcements.

models.name: Asym Twin +
models.description: A newly developed asym twin based off a combination my favorite mid length asym and performance asym. This board features two channels on the heel side and one on the toe side and a double concave inside a belly vee. This concept was developed for a combination of low drama late drops, plenty of available speed, and larger arcing carves, ideally in overhead surf. Glassed in 4oz S cloth with a 4s fin patch on the bottom, and double 4s on the deck, this board is the perfect combination of strength and light weight. A lati wood fin plug reinforcement helps ensure longevity of the toe side fin plug.

models.name: East Coast Tube Shooter
models.description: This board was designed for the heavier East Coast days. Slight entry vee helps cut through surface chop. Mid board features a double concave set inside a single that fades to pure double under the fins and vee out the tail. Glassed with Hexcel 4oz S cloth on the bottom and 4oz S + 6oz S on the deck and an Applecore stringer, this board is built to withstand the beatings handed out at heavy beach breaks.
